title: Steam Clone (Game Purchase Platform)
about: Built a Steam-inspired game purchasing platform using the MERN stack with game browsing, downloads, admin approval workflows, and MongoDB persistence. Implemented RBAC, JWT authentication with AES encryption, email-based OTP (2FA), and protected frontend routes. Enhanced security using RSA digital signatures, bcrypt hashing, SHA-256 token storage, audit logging, and middleware-based access control.

title: Personal Bookmarks Chrome Extension
about: Developed a Chrome extension for capturing and managing bookmarks through manual entry and active-tab extraction. Integrated Chrome Tabs API and localStorage for persistent bookmark storage and retrieval. Built a dynamic user interface using DOM manipulation, event-driven programming, and Chrome extension architecture.

title: Expense Monitor
about: Built a multi-user expense tracking application using Ruby on Rails MVC architecture with SQLite persistence. Developed responsive dashboards and expense categorization features for tracking spending patterns. Implemented CRUD workflows, server-side validations, and user-specific account management.

title: Online Shopping App (E-Commerce)
about: A full-stack CRUD-based shopping application where users can browse, add, edit, and delete items. Features product database integration, responsive dashboard UI, and custom category filtering.

title: Think Board
about: A MERN-based notes application designed for fast, minimal, and distraction-free note-taking. Features real-time CRUD operations, organized note management, and a clean UI focused on productivity.

title: Rocket Animation
about: A C++ and OpenGL-based graphics project that animates a rocket using classic computer graphics algorithms, including Bresenham’s line drawing, scanline polygon fill, Cohen–Sutherland line clipping, and 2D transformations.
